data.user_prompt: How should structured data describe a consultant and their qualifications?

sections.text:
Structured data describing a consultant and their qualifications should use a schema that clearly defines the person, their professional role, and their credentials. The most commonly used vocabulary for this purpose is Schema.org, which is widely supported by search engines and other platforms.

Here’s how you can structure this data using Schema.org vocabulary in JSON-LD format:

```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Person",
  "name": "John Doe",
  "jobTitle": "Business Consultant",
  "worksFor": {
    "@type": "Organization",
    "name": "Consulting Experts Inc."
  },
  "description": "Experienced business consultant specializing in strategy and operations.",
  "alumniOf": {
    "@type": "EducationalOrganization",
    "name": "University of Business"
  },
  "hasCredential": [
    {
      "@type": "EducationalOccupationalCredential",
      "credentialCategory": "Professional Certification",
      "name": "Certified Management Consultant (CMC)",
      "awardingBody": {
        "@type": "Organization",
        "name": "Institute of Management Consultants"
      }
    },
    {
      "@type": "EducationalOccupationalCredential",
      "credentialCategory": "Degree",
      "name": "MBA in Business Administration",
      "awardingBody": {
        "@type": "EducationalOrganization",
        "name": "University of Business"
      }
    }
  ],
  "email": "john.doe@example.com",
  "telephone": "+1-555-555-5555",
  "url": "https://www.johndoeconsulting.com"
}
```

### Key elements to include:
- `@type`: Use "Person" to describe the consultant.
- `name`: Full name of the consultant.
- `jobTitle`: Their professional title.
- `worksFor`: The organization or company they work for.
- `description`: A brief summary of their expertise.
- `alumniOf`: Educational background.
- `hasCredential`: List of certifications, degrees, or other qualifications.
- `email`, `telephone`, `url`: Contact information.

This structured data helps search engines and other systems understand the consultant’s profile and qualifications clearly. If you want, I can help you generate a customized structured data snippet for a specific consultant.
